Summary: Pelican builds in-vehicle assistants for ride-fleet operators (driver+passenger). Very latency- and cost-sensitive; primary constraint is 95th pct generation latency under 60ms for short-turn dialogs. Interested in Redwood's Dedicated or Private for regional residency and to meet offline/edge sync scenarios.

Highlights / requirements (from calls):
- Workload: sub-200-token prompts, rapid turn-taking chat with per-session personalization. Also background embedding extraction from telemetry frames for intent detection.
- Targets: 95th pct latency < 60ms on typical 8-token generations; sustained 300-500 QPS per region during peak; cold-start tail mitigation critical.
- Cost sensitivity: tight unit economics for fleet scale — target is to reduce per-interaction inference cost by ~50-70% vs current full-precision endpoints.
- Technical asks: aggressive INT8/4-bit quantization profiles with quality regression thresholds; persistent KV/prefix caching for session state; dynamic batching that respects per-request latency SLOs; automated fallback routing when dedicated pool is saturated.
- Security/compliance: EU data must stay in-region for EU clients; SSO (SAML) for ops; audit logs and KMS integration for keys; retention controls for PII extracted from telemetry.
